domains.subtitle: Point a domain at this server, then choose how HTTPS is handled

dnsHint.createARecord: Create an A record pointing to
dnsHint.cloudflareOk: Cloudflare proxy can be turned on, it is supported

form.pathPrefixNote: (optional, leave empty for the whole host)
form.pathPrefixHelp: Only requests whose path starts with this value. It always wins over the "whole host" row of the same hostname.
form.externalProxy: TLS is handled by an external proxy (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager, Cloudflare, load balancer)
form.externalProxyNote: The external proxy terminates TLS and Zixploy serves plain HTTP to it (turning on HTTPS/redirect here would cause a redirect loop)

empty.title: No domains yet
empty.hint: Add a domain to receive traffic from outside

dns.checkFailed: Could not run the DNS check. Refresh the page and try again.
dns.proxyLoopWarning: DNS for this domain goes through a proxy/CDN. If TLS is terminated at the proxy, turning on HTTPS/redirect here causes a redirect loop. Consider the "TLS is handled by an external proxy" mode under HTTPS settings.

valid.label: Points to this server
valid.hint: The domain is ready to receive traffic

proxied.label: Behind Cloudflare
proxied.hint: Cloudflare proxy is on. DDoS protection is active and traffic reaches this server through Cloudflare.

mismatch.label: Points elsewhere
mismatch.hint: The current A record does not point to this server and is not Cloudflare. Fix it at your DNS provider.

unknown.label: Does not resolve
unknown.hint: No DNS record yet, or it has not propagated (wait 5–30 minutes after creating the record)

tls.title: TLS certificate
tls.letsEncryptHint: Certificates are requested and renewed automatically. Port 80 must be reachable from outside.
tls.customHint: An uploaded certificate is not renewed automatically. Upload a new one before it expires.
tls.pasteHint: Paste PEM into both fields. The certificate must cover {hostname} and the private key must have no passphrase.

expiry.expired: Expired {n} day ago, upload a new one | Expired {n} days ago, upload a new one
expiry.today: Expires today, upload a new one
expiry.soon: {n} day left, prepare a new one | {n} days left, prepare a new one

delete.confirm: Delete domain {hostname}? Incoming traffic will no longer be routed.
